verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an API-based (server-driven) Terminal integration alongside its SDKs. The API extends to fleet tasks such as locations, zones and reader registration, plus refunds via the Refunds API, and server-driven integrations get a simulated reader for testing. Stripe also publishes an OpenAPI specification repository, and a community developer praises the ability to 'fully integrate with the API on a terminal level.' Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail for the Terminal-specific API surface (e.g., driving a payment on a reader) in the evidence, and an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable docs URL (probe paths returned 404).
